objective: Measure whether the encoder-only fixed-width Vec extension reduces dirty uv build work, with no attribute-cache stacking.

fixed_cargo.source_scope: The accepted dependency-search-prefix Cargo artifact is fixed identically in both arms.

fixture.edit: Reuse the exact dirty_fixture.py content() function and measurement/pair marker arguments: deterministic non-doc BEFORE/AFTER comments with identical lengths. No tracked uv change beyond the reversible fixture edit.
fixture.state: Fresh independent runtime, target, shared/build and Cargo-home state banks for each encoder compiler, activated at identical common paths. No compiled state or outcomes imported from the attribute experiment. Source/archive dependency seeds may be reused under the existing policy.
fixture.namespaces: Freshly capture each arm unchanged. Prove any compiler-identity namespace path delta and OUT_DIR-only environment delta with the existing validator; never rewrite argv to make arms look equal.
fixture.incremental: Keep the captured uv -C incremental setting. The compiler-build CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 setting is not a workload override.

required_before_execution: Root acceptance of this prospective plan; no measurements, warming or large transfer is authorized by this document.
Coordinate runtime transfer; authenticate all per-file hashes and verify both runtime/sysroot identities on the chosen measurement host.
Adapt only existing harness plan/source/path bindings and fixed threshold literals; independently review/freeze the exact runnable sources.
The terminal-observation successor must pass its pending independent review and Root acceptance before adoption. No older failed cohort or effect is admitted.
Fresh per-arm warming, captured ordered argv/environment, compiler namespace proof, exact output/diagnostic admission, host/tool bindings and preflight acceptance.

Require output equivalence under the existing source-backed admission logic with newly established encoder bindings. Do not inherit attribute-specific output hashes, exceptions or serialized-metadata conclusions.
Separate exact authority for each fixed stage, after accepted restoration from its predecessor; keep actual mutable state rows unbound until then.
correctness_preflight: Use the sealed five-pass canonical encoder tests and exact old/new byte-equivalence regression; no attribute-cache-hit prerequisite applies.
Verify the ordinary uv-library invocation remains dirty after the same edit, has incremental state enabled, and executes the expected compiler work.
Run actual fresh check/test-build convergence and child-work/diagnostic/output validation through the existing preparation path; no uv tests execute.
Preserve source/tool/runtime/output/restoration guards and normal cache/trust policy. Investigate any mismatch before freezing a cohort.

primary.case: Ordinary uv-library invocation from a dirty cargo test --no-run build
primary.metric: Whole rustc-process Callgrind final Ir, including its threads and in-process proc macro; compiler children are not included
primary.scope: Isolated compiler invocation, not whole Cargo command or macro-only instructions
primary.preparation: Before every sample, activate that compiler's own state, warm the BEFORE source through the original test-build command outside measurement, apply the unchanged AFTER edit, then execute that arm's freshly captured standalone ordinary uv-library rustc argv/environment. Repeated AFTER-only replays are forbidden.
primary.environment: Exact fresh captured argv/ordered environment; omit only documented unusable jobserver FDs; no self-profile flags during measurement
primary.normalizer: Existing pinned task-owned Valgrind environment normalizer; no child instrumentation
primary.host_policy: Record competing activity without filtering otherwise-valid instruction samples; balanced orders; no claim of independent scheduling noise

estimator.interval: Two-sided 99% paired bootstrap percentile interval over log ratios
estimator.sign_test: Exact two-sided sign test; eight of eight wins gives p=0.0078125

stage_sequence: Both fresh instruction confirmation blocks must pass before either native endpoint starts. Stop at a failed instruction gate; do not extend or select pairs.

native.metric: Uninstrumented complete command elapsed wall time, no tests executed
native.preparation: Warm the same before-source version outside timing, then apply the same after-source edit before each sample
native.host_policy: Pending accepted terminal-boundary amendment: strict entry admission and immediate pre/post measured-command quiet checks. Any retained guard failure invalidates the whole attempt before effects. Terminal host activity after untimed cleanup is recorded observationally only; restoration/context/output/parking failures still reject. No pair deletion or effect-based exclusions.
native.wall_time_claim: Only if both fresh eight-pair blocks for that endpoint have all eight wins and each 99% lower bound exceeds zero
native.regression_blocker: For either endpoint, reject performance acceptance if losses >= 12 of 16 AND the pooled reduction_CI99.upper < -1.0 percent. Pool the two fixed native blocks with equal pair weights; exclude discovery and all instruction samples.
native.inconclusive: Report signed point estimate, interval and wins/losses. Do not infer equivalence or a wall-time improvement from instruction gains.

lifecycle.sample: Select own arm state; restore/check original source; write BEFORE and converge the original workload outside measurement; apply equal-length AFTER; measure exactly once; validate; restore source. No convergence command is inserted between measured arms beyond the next arm's required BEFORE warm-up.
lifecycle.stage_end: Restore source and mode; for each touched arm run original check and test-build convergence once; park all state. Keep the existing nested restoration handling.
lifecycle.affinity: Workload CPUs 0-7; controller CPU 8. Local preparation helpers must stop for native quiet windows.
lifecycle.settle: One fixed 30-second settle at stage entry, before host admission; no per-sample added sleep.

terminal_boundary.proposal_scope: For all fresh encoder native blocks, retain strict entry and immediate measured BEFORE/AFTER quiet checks. Only post-cleanup terminal host activity is observational; terminal source/Cargo/runtime/output/restoration/convergence/parking validity remains mandatory.

source_reuse.note: References are source/control material only. No attribute sample, profile total, timing result, or compiled workload state is reused.

raw_validity: Authenticate all raw commands, argv/environment, diagnostics, outputs, source/runtime state, restores and profile bytes before effects. Use existing whole-process final-Ir parser and raw/self/stderr consistency checks; preserve accepted warnings/header offsets explicitly. Never substitute Cargo-parent Ir, a function subtotal or Callgrind wall time.
instruction_host_policy: Record and retain competing activity without filtering otherwise-valid instruction samples, matching the existing prospective policy.
decision_scope: Correctness and both instruction confirmations must pass; either native endpoint's fixed regression blocker prevents performance acceptance. Native improvement claims require that endpoint's separate wall gate. Publication and execution remain separately authorized.
retry_policy: No sample-size extensions, effect-based exclusions or retrospective threshold changes. Infrastructure failures retain all outputs and end the attempt; any replacement attempt requires a prospective recorded reason before inspecting its new effects.
limitations: This is one exact dirty uv edit and the ordinary uv-library compiler process, not a macro-only or whole-command instruction endpoint.
Matched development builds are compared only with each other, not with the shipped PGO/BOLT SDK.
Compiler instructions cannot establish native elapsed-time improvement; report all valid native signed estimates, intervals and wins/losses even if inconclusive.
No attribute-cache source, measurements or benefit is stacked into this candidate.
Memory and broader workloads remain unmeasured.
